_about: Multi-stage routes to permanent residence. Each step links an official page read on the 'checked' date. Only transitions an official page supports are listed; a temporary visa is never assumed to lead to residence. Durations the page doesn't state are null and reported as unknown.

pathways.title: Study, then work on a PGWP, then permanent residence (Canadian Experience Class)

steps.label: Work on a Post-Graduation Work Permit
steps.years_note: The year of Canadian work in the next step is done on this permit. PGWP length depends on the level and length of your programme (up to 3 years) and your passport's validity.

steps.label: Apply for permanent residence through the Canadian Experience Class
steps.years_note: After at least 1 year (1,560 hours) of skilled Canadian work in the last 3 years

notes: Work in TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3, gained in Canada while authorised to work
Meet the minimum score in all four language abilities on an approved test

limits: Meeting the minimum puts you in the Express Entry pool; permanent residence needs an invitation from a competitive draw.
The PGWP page doesn't say that PGWP work counts towards residence; the Canadian Experience Class page requires Canadian work gained while authorised to work.

pathways.title: Study, then the Graduate visa, then Skilled Worker, then settlement

steps.label: Graduate visa
steps.years_note: 2 years for bachelor's and master's graduates applying by 31 December 2026, 18 months from 1 January 2027, 3 years after a PhD. It can't be extended.
steps.condition: Your university confirms you completed your course

steps.label: Switch to a Skilled Worker visa
steps.years_note: Settlement after 5 years on the Skilled Worker visa

limits: The Graduate visa page doesn't say the Graduate visa counts towards settlement, so the 5 years are counted from the Skilled Worker visa.
Skilled Worker needs a job offer from a licensed sponsor.

pathways.title: EU Blue Card, then a settlement permit

steps.label: Work on an EU Blue Card
steps.years_note: The months in the next step are counted while you hold the Blue Card

steps.label: Settlement permit
steps.years_note: After 21 months with B1 German, or 27 months with A1

limits: Below A1 German the page gives no settlement timeline for Blue Card holders.
